title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the Lamborghini Countach
description:
Most Lamborghinis are named after fighting bulls. The Miura, the Espada, the Diablo. The Countach is not. Its name is a word of astonishment, and the story of where it came from is only half documented. And the car that wears it was designed with a periscope, because the driver could not see out of the back. These are two things you may not know about the Lamborghini Countach. We will take them one at a time: the name, and the periscope. Along the way we will also look at what the sources say about the prototype that was destroyed on purpose, the scissor doors, and the numbers. Every fact comes from a published source, listed in the description. Where sources disagree, we tell you. Where we do the maths, we say so.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
